MAR.note: The framework bill is described in general terms; no harm from AI is named as addressed by a draft rule.
States no AI system used in public administration.

facts.fact: Digital-transition minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni said on 23 May 2025 that her department has drawn up, with stakeholders, a draft framework law on AI setting principles, compliance obligations, regulation mechanisms and ethical guarantees.
facts.system: Draft framework law on artificial intelligence

MAR.note: States no AI tool in a public sector system.
States no AI model, dataset or computing built in the country.
Mentions personal data protection only as a theme of a future AI law; states nothing on a data protection law.
States nothing on public bodies sharing data.
